model_policy.cheap: Fast low-cost model with strong instruction following for bounded prose tasks.
model_policy.balanced: Mid-tier model for synthesis, governance, curricula, and operational design.
model_policy.strong: Highest-capability model reserved for thesis-critical synthesis, adversarial review, and integration.
model_policy.code: Low-cost coding-capable model for deterministic scripts and repository checks.
